title: Valid snapshot with an explicit billing cycle
description: 41 consecutive quarter-hour chunks = 10.25 hours. The first 10 hours are free; the last paid chunk is peak usage. Base $0.25 + surcharge $0.05 = $0.30.

title: Array instead of integer: skip one event
description: The exact client example: duration_minutes is [15]. That event is skipped, the valid event remains, and X-Invalid-Event-Count is 1.

title: Duplicate user IDs reject the request
description: Two users have user_id alice. This is a request-level error, unlike duplicate events; HTTP 400 and no invalid-event header.

title: Omitted cycle uses the user's current month
description: billing_cycle is absent. 41 valid events use the generation month's dates and cost $0.30. The returned cycle uses the server clock. The Postman pre-request script refreshes event dates to the current UTC month automatically; standalone JSON/cURL files are dated snapshots and can be refreshed by rerunning the generator.

title: Wrong values and missing fields are skipped
description: Skips duration 20, start time 10:07, an invalid date, a missing duration, and null. One valid 15-minute event remains; invalid count 5.

title: Duplicate event IDs are counted once
description: The first valid event wins. The repeated ID is skipped, so usage is 15 minutes rather than 30 minutes; invalid count 1.

title: Unknown event user is skipped
description: An event references a user absent from users. That event is skipped; the known user's event is still billed.

title: Users with no events receive zero bills
description: Both listed users receive a bill in input order even though events is empty.

title: Invalid user timezone rejects the request
description: The user timezone is needed for month boundaries; an invalid timezone is a request-level HTTP 400 error.

title: Invalid explicit month rejects the request
description: Month 13 does not follow the required YYYY-MM cycle format; HTTP 400.

title: The same UTC instant belongs to different local months
description: 2026-09-30T21:00Z is October 1 in Sofia but September 30 in UTC. For billing_cycle 2026-10, only Sofia's event counts. The UTC user's valid out-of-month event does not increase the invalid count.

title: Enterprise grace counts toward the rate threshold
description: Each user has 100 hours from 400 chronological off-peak chunks. Regular: 90 eligible/paid hours at $1 = $90. Enterprise: 100 eligible hours selects $0.80, but only 90 paid hours = $72. The free allowance is per user. This is intentionally the larger request; import the collection to avoid copying its long cURL.

title: 16:45 is peak; 17:00 is off-peak
description: Both users get their own 10 free hours. Each then has one paid quarter hour: 16:45 UTC costs $0.30 with surcharge; 17:00 UTC costs $0.25 without surcharge.

title: All invalid events still produce a successful batch
description: null, an empty event object and an array-valued duration are all invalid. Return HTTP 200, a zero bill, and invalid count 3.

title: The events container itself must be an array
description: An event may be malformed, but events itself must be an array. This request has an object instead and returns HTTP 400.

title: Truncated JSON rejects the entire document
description: request.json is intentionally invalid JSON (the closing brace is missing). Item recovery cannot repair a broken document; HTTP 400.
